title: RC-21 sibling: the dashboard position broadcast is a setInterval(async) every 5 s with no in-flight guard, and each cycle quotes every open position on the shared RPC with no timeout, so slow RPC stacks overlapping cycles while a dashboard tab is open

evidence.note: setInterval(async () => { if (getClientCount() === 0) return; await buildPositionsWithLivePrices(contexts); ... }, 5000): no running flag
Promise.all over every open position, each calling queryPrice (the exit engine quote, no timeout; AUD-EXIT-005)
GET /api/positions runs the same live quote for every position per request

sibling_sites_checked: All timers in src/api: server.ts:186 (this finding; cleared in close() at :218), auth.ts:22 (session cleanup, unref, synchronous, correct). The per-position exit poll with the same pattern is AUD-EXIT-005 (RC-21, EXIT slice, card EXIT-04). The dashboard Chain Controls page opens an extra socket per visit (DASH slice).
severity_rationale: S3: only while a dashboard client is connected; the quotes are display-only, but they share the HTTP provider and its rate limit with the exit monitors, so a slow RPC doubles the quote load and lets cycles pile up. Lower than the S2 of the exit-path entry AUD-EXIT-005 because no exit decision depends on these cycles.
recommendation: Self-rescheduling setTimeout (skip while a cycle runs), withTimeout on each quote, and reuse the exit monitor's latest quote instead of quoting again. Same fix pattern as card EXIT-04. Phase 29.
